name: Bear Paw (Combat)
body:
You wield massive weapons that are larger than you should normally be able to handle.

Prerequisite: Str 13, base attack bonus +1, ursine.

Benefit: You can use a melee weapon in your primary hand or in two hands that is one size larger than you without penalty.
